title: Girl allegedly grabbed during abduction attempt
text:
Stated Claim / Post Context:
Girl allegedly grabbed during abduction attempt

Police arrest a man who allegedly picked up and carried off a child during an attempted abduction in Adelaide's northern suburbs on Monday evening.

Police arrested an 18-year-old man following an investigation into the alleged abduction attempt. (ABC News: Che Chorley)

A man who allegedly grabbed a child during an attempted abduction in Adelaide's north earlier this week has been arrested following police investigations.

The incident occurred on Monday just before 7:30pm when a couple and small girl were walking along Niven Drive at Paralowie, police said.

They said a man picked up the girl "and carried her a short distance, before putting her down again".

The suspect was last seen on Marvin Way, police said.

An 18-year-old Paralowie man was later arrested by CIB detectives following investigations.

The man was charged with the abduction of a child and was refused police bail.

Police said he would appear in the Elizabeth Magistrates Court today.
